bee.name: Room Air Conditioner (Fixed Speed), up to 10,465 W
bee.labs: Intertek (Sohna), TUV Rheinland (Bengaluru), UL India (Manesar), SGS, ITC India
bee.summary: Room Air Conditioner (Fixed Speed), up to 10,465 W — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 1391 (Part 1); ISEER method. Mandatory since 2010.

bee.name: Room AC (Inverter / Variable Speed; incl. Cassette, Floor-Standing Tower, Ceiling, Corner types)
bee.labs: Intertek, TUV Rheinland, UL India, SGS, ITC India
bee.summary: Room AC (Inverter / Variable Speed; incl. Cassette, Floor-Standing Tower, Ceiling, Corner types) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 1391 (Part 2); ISO 16358-1 (CSPF/ISEER). Mandatory 2020; new types 1 Jan 2026.

bee.name: Frost Free Refrigerator
bee.labs: Intertek, TUV SUD, TUV Rheinland, SGS, URS Labs
bee.summary: Frost Free Refrigerator — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 15750 / IS 17550 (IEC 62552). Mandatory since 2010.

bee.name: Direct Cool Refrigerator
bee.labs: Intertek, TUV SUD, TUV Rheinland, SGS, URS Labs
bee.summary: Direct Cool Refrigerator — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 1476 (Part 1) / IS 17550. Mandatory since 1 Jan 2016.

bee.name: Deep Freezer
bee.labs: Intertek, TUV SUD, SGS, ITC India
bee.summary: Deep Freezer — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 7872; IEC 62552 method. Mandatory 1 Jan 2026 (voluntary since Mar 2020).

bee.name: Ceiling Fan (incl. BLDC)
bee.labs: ERTL(N) Delhi, Spectro, ITC India, Intertek
bee.summary: Ceiling Fan (incl. BLDC) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 374:2019; service value. Mandatory 1 Jan 2023.

bee.name: Colour TV / Ultra-HD TV
bee.starTable: Revised table effective 1 Jan 2026 (TV ratings shifted up 1 star)
bee.labs: Intertek, UL India, TUV Rheinland, Spectro
bee.summary: Colour TV / Ultra-HD TV — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 616 (safety); IEC 62087 energy method. Mandatory 2010; UHD 1 Jan 2026.

bee.name: Electric Storage Water Heater (Geyser)
bee.labs: Intertek, ITC India, Spectro, TUV Rheinland
bee.summary: Electric Storage Water Heater (Geyser) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 2082; standing loss. Mandatory since 2015.

bee.name: Washing Machine
bee.labs: Intertek, TUV Rheinland, UL India, SGS
bee.summary: Washing Machine — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 302-2-7 (safety); IEC 60456 performance. Mandatory 1 Jul 2023.

bee.name: Tubular Fluorescent Lamp
bee.labs: ERTL, Spectro, Nemko, ITC India
bee.summary: Tubular Fluorescent Lamp — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 2418. Mandatory since 2010.

bee.name: LED Lamp (Self-Ballasted)
bee.labs: Spectro, ERTL, Nemko, ITC India
bee.summary: LED Lamp (Self-Ballasted) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 16102 (Pt 1&2); IS 16106 / LM-79 photometry. Mandatory 1 Jan 2018.

bee.name: Distribution Transformer (up to 2500 kVA)
bee.labs: ERDA Vadodara, CPRI (Bengaluru/Bhopal/Noida), NHPTL
bee.summary: Distribution Transformer (up to 2500 kVA) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 1180 (Part 1); losses at 50% & 100% load. Mandatory since 2010.

bee.name: Domestic LPG Stove
bee.labs: Shriram Institute (Delhi), ITC India, BIS-recognised IS 4246 labs
bee.summary: Domestic LPG Stove — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per IS 4246 (thermal efficiency). Mandatory 1 Jan 2026.

bee.name: Chiller (Water / Air Cooled)
bee.labs: AHRI-certified labs; witnessed factory testing per schedule; Intertek
bee.summary: Chiller (Water / Air Cooled) — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per AHRI 550/590 / 551/591; IS 16590; IPLV. Mandatory 1 Jan 2026 (voluntary since 2018).

bee.name: Cooling Tower
bee.labs: CTI-certified test agencies; NABL mechanical labs
bee.summary: Cooling Tower — BEE star labelling (mandatory). Tested as per CTI STD-201 / ATC-105 thermal performance. Mandatory 1 Jan 2026.

eu.name: Automotive industry
eu.mandate: EU Vehicle Type-Approval Framework; General Safety Regulation
eu.testing: UNECE regulation-based testing: crash & occupant safety (R94/R95/R137), braking (R13/R13-H), lighting (R48 series), EMC (R10), emissions (Euro 6/7 — WLTP, RDE), tyres (R117), ADAS (AEB, LKA, ISA), cybersecurity (R155) & software update (R156) audits
eu.whenNb: All vehicles/systems/components require type-approval testing by designated Technical Services and approval by a national Type-Approval Authority — self-declaration not permitted
eu.route: e-mark / EU WVTA certificate (no CE mark)
eu.updates: Automated/connected vehicle safety rules expanding; e-mark approvals for components
eu.summary: Automotive industry: EU Vehicle Type-Approval Framework; General Safety Regulation. NB: YES (equivalent).

eu.name: Biotechnology
eu.mandate: Policy area; bio-based products (EU Biotech Act in preparation)
eu.testing: Product-dependent: bio-based content testing (EN 16785-1/-2), biodegradability (EN 13432 for packaging claims); GMO/medicinal products tested under EFSA/EMA frameworks
eu.whenNb: No horizontal NB regime; sector products fall under other frameworks (medicinal, food, cosmetics) with their own assessment bodies
eu.route: N/A — claim substantiation / other regimes
eu.updates: EU Biotech Act announced; watch for biomanufacturing measures
eu.summary: Biotechnology: Policy area; bio-based products (EU Biotech Act in preparation). NB: NO.

eu.name: Chemicals — REACH / CLP
eu.mandate: REACH registration & restriction; CLP classification, labelling, packaging; Poison Centre Notification
eu.testing: Physico-chemical, toxicological & ecotoxicological testing per REACH Annexes VII–X (tonnage-based) under GLP; SVHC screening (phthalates, PFAS, heavy metals) for articles; CLP hazard classification testing (flammability, corrosivity, aquatic toxicity)
eu.whenNb: No notified body — compliance via ECHA registration dossiers, GLP-accredited lab data & Only Representative for non-EU manufacturers
eu.route: No CE — ECHA registration no.; SDS & CLP labelling
eu.summary: Chemicals — REACH / CLP: REACH registration & restriction; CLP classification, labelling, packaging; Poison Centre Notification. NB: NO.

eu.name: Chemicals — Fertilising Products
eu.testing: Nutrient content analysis, contaminant limits (Cd, Pb, Hg, As, Ni, Cr VI), pathogen testing (Salmonella, E. coli), biuret in urea, chelating agent stability; sampling per EN 1482; methods per Reg. annexes / EN standards
eu.whenNb: Module A self-assessment allowed only for a few product function categories; Modules A1, B+C, D1 (e.g., compost, digestate, blends) require NB
eu.route: CE marking + NB number where applicable
eu.summary: Chemicals — Fertilising Products: EU Fertilising Products Regulation (FPR). NB: YES (most modules).

eu.name: Construction sector
eu.testing: Testing per harmonised standards/EADs by AVCP system: reaction to fire (EN 13501-1), fire resistance, mechanical strength (e.g., EN 206 concrete, EN 14351 windows), thermal performance, dangerous substance release, durability; factory production control audits
eu.whenNb: System 1+/1: NB certifies product incl. audit testing; 2+: NB certifies FPC; 3: NB test lab issues type-test report; System 4: manufacturer self-assessment, no NB
eu.route: CE + Declaration of Performance (DoP)
eu.updates: Revised CPR in force 2025; phased application; Digital Product Passport planned
eu.summary: Construction sector: Construction Products Regulation (CPR). NB: YES (Systems 1+, 1, 2+, 3).

eu.name: Cosmetics
eu.testing: Safety assessment (CPSR Annex I) by qualified assessor; microbiological testing (ISO 17516, challenge test ISO 11930), stability & compatibility, preservative efficacy, heavy metals/trace impurities, restricted substances (Annexes II–VI) — no animal testing permitted
eu.whenNb: No NB — Responsible Person ensures PIF + CPNP notification; market surveillance by Member States
eu.route: No CE — CPNP reference; INCI labelling
eu.updates: TPO banned in nail products (CMR) from 1 Sept 2025; Omnibus ingredient updates ongoing
eu.summary: Cosmetics: EU Cosmetics Regulation. NB: NO.

eu.name: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — LVD
eu.testing: Electrical safety testing: EN 62368-1 (AV/ICT), EN 60335 series (household appliances), EN 60598 (luminaires) — hi-pot, insulation resistance, leakage current, temperature rise, abnormal operation, glow-wire
eu.whenNb: LVD has NO notified bodies at all — always manufacturer self-declaration (internal production control), but accredited lab test reports expected as evidence
eu.route: CE — self-declaration (DoC)
eu.summary: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — LVD: Low Voltage Directive. NB: NO.

eu.name: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — EMC
eu.testing: Emissions: EN 55032/CISPR 32, EN 61000-3-2/-3-3 (harmonics/flicker); Immunity: EN 55035, EN 61000-4 series (ESD, radiated, EFT, surge, conducted, dips)
eu.whenNb: Self-declaration standard route; NB involvement voluntary (opinion on technical documentation) — never mandatory
eu.route: CE — self-declaration (DoC)
eu.summary: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive. NB: NO (optional).

eu.name: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — RED
eu.testing: Radio spectrum: EN 300 328 (Wi-Fi/BT 2.4 GHz), EN 301 893 (5 GHz), EN 300 220 (SRD); EMC: EN 301 489 series; Safety: EN 62368-1; SAR/RF exposure: EN 50360/50566, EN 62311; Cybersecurity: EN 18031-1/-2/-3 (Art. 3.3 d/e/f, mandatory since Aug 2025)
eu.whenNb: Self-declaration ONLY if harmonised standards applied in full; any deviation/partial application (incl. EN 18031 gaps) → NB EU-Type Examination (Module B) mandatory
eu.route: CE — DoC or NB Type-Exam Cert
eu.summary: Electrical & Electronic (EEI) — RED: Radio Equipment Directive. NB: CONDITIONAL.

eu.name: Firearms
eu.testing: Proof testing of firearms per CIP (Permanent International Commission) proof-house standards; deactivation verification per Reg. (EU) 2015/2403 technical specifications; alarm/signal weapon convertibility testing
eu.whenNb: National proof houses & verifying authorities mandatory — not CE notified bodies but compulsory third-party verification
eu.route: Proof marks / deactivation certificate
eu.summary: Firearms: Firearms Directive + implementing acts. NB: YES (equivalent).

eu.name: Agri-food Industrial Ecosystem
eu.mandate: General Food Law & hygiene package (DG SANTE); Agri-Food Code initiative
eu.testing: Microbiological criteria (Reg. 2073/2005 — Salmonella, Listeria), contaminants (Reg. 2023/915 — mycotoxins, heavy metals), pesticide MRLs (Reg. 396/2005), food contact material migration (Reg. 10/2011), nutrition labelling verification
eu.whenNb: No NB — official controls by Member State authorities; accredited lab testing + HACCP; third-party certification (BRC, FSSC 22000) commercial, not legal
eu.route: No CE — food law compliance & labelling
eu.updates: Agri-Food Code initiative; transition pathway co-implementation
eu.summary: Agri-food Industrial Ecosystem: General Food Law & hygiene package (DG SANTE); Agri-Food Code initiative. NB: NO.

eu.name: Legal Metrology — MID / NAWID
eu.mandate: Measuring Instruments Directive; Non-Automatic Weighing Instruments Directive
eu.testing: Accuracy class testing per OIML recommendations (R76 scales, R49 water meters, R117 fuel dispensers), influence factor tests (temperature, humidity, EMC per WELMEC), durability, software validation (WELMEC 7.2)
eu.whenNb: All MID/NAWID instruments require NB: Module B+D/B+F, D1, F1, G or H1 — no self-declaration route for placing on market
eu.route: CE + supplementary metrology 'M' marking + NB no.
eu.summary: Legal Metrology — MID / NAWID: Measuring Instruments Directive; Non-Automatic Weighing Instruments Directive. NB: YES.

eu.name: Maritime — Recreational Craft
eu.testing: Stability & buoyancy (ISO 12217), hull scantlings (ISO 12215), fire protection (ISO 9094), fuel/electrical systems (ISO 10088, ISO 13297), engine exhaust emissions (ISO 18854), noise (ISO 14509), CIN coding (ISO 10087)
eu.whenNb: Design cat. A & B: NB mandatory (most modules); cat. C ≥12 m: NB; small cat. C/D craft with full hEN: Module A self-assessment possible; Post-Construction Assessment (imports) always via NB
eu.route: CE + builder's plate + CIN
eu.summary: Maritime — Recreational Craft: Recreational Craft Directive. NB: CONDITIONAL → YES.

eu.name: Mechanical — Machinery
eu.testing: Risk assessment per EN ISO 12100; safety of control systems (EN ISO 13849-1); electrical (EN 60204-1); guards & interlocks (EN ISO 14119/14120); emergency stop (EN ISO 13850); noise measurement; category-specific C-standards
eu.whenNb: Ordinary machinery: self-assessment (Module A). Annex I Part A high-risk (incl. certain AI safety components): NB mandatory even with hEN. Annex I Part B: NB unless hEN fully applied
eu.route: CE — DoC or NB Type-Exam
eu.summary: Mechanical — Machinery: Machinery Regulation (replacing Machinery Directive 20 Jan 2027). NB: CONDITIONAL.

eu.name: Mechanical — Lifts
eu.testing: EN 81-20 (safety requirements) & EN 81-50 (design verification tests): overspeed governor, safety gear, buffers, landing door fire tests (EN 81-58), electrical safety circuits
eu.whenNb: Every lift & safety component requires NB conformity assessment (type-exam, final inspection, unit verification or full QA modules) — no self-declaration
eu.route: CE + NB number
eu.summary: Mechanical — Lifts: Lifts Directive. NB: YES.

eu.name: Mechanical — PPE
eu.testing: Category-specific EN testing: helmets (EN 397), safety footwear (EN ISO 20345), gloves (EN 388 mechanical, EN 374 chemical), respiratory (EN 149 FFP), eye protection (EN 166), fall arrest (EN 361/355), hi-vis (EN ISO 20471)
eu.whenNb: Cat I (minimal risk): self-declaration. Cat II: NB EU type-exam. Cat III (life-threatening risks): NB type-exam + ongoing surveillance (Module C2 or D)
eu.route: CE (+ NB no. for Cat III)
eu.summary: Mechanical — PPE: PPE Regulation. NB: CONDITIONAL (Cat II & III: YES).

eu.name: Mechanical — ATEX
eu.testing: Explosion protection testing: EN IEC 60079 series (flameproof 'd', increased safety 'e', intrinsic safety 'i'), non-electrical EN ISO 80079-36/-37; temperature classification, ingress protection, spark ignition risk
eu.nb: CONDITIONAL (Group I & II Cat 1/2 electrical: YES)
eu.whenNb: Equipment-cat. 1 & 2 (electrical + internal combustion): NB type-exam mandatory; Cat 2 non-electrical: technical file lodged with NB; Cat 3: self-assessment
eu.route: CE + Ex marking (+ NB no.)
eu.summary: Mechanical — ATEX: ATEX Equipment Directive. NB: CONDITIONAL (Group I & II Cat 1/2 electrical: YES).

eu.name: Pressure Equipment & Gas Appliances
eu.mandate: Pressure Equipment Directive; Simple Pressure Vessels; Gas Appliances Regulation
eu.testing: PED: design verification per EN 13445 (vessels)/EN 13480 (piping), hydrostatic proof test (1.43×PS), NDT (RT/UT of welds), material certs (EN 10204 3.1/3.2), welder qualification (EN ISO 9606); GAR: EN 30 series / EN 15502 type testing, combustion & CO safety
eu.whenNb: PED Cat I: self-assessment (Module A); Cat II–IV: NB mandatory (modules A2→G/H1 by category); SEP (sound engineering practice): no CE. GAR: NB type-exam always mandatory for appliances & fittings
eu.route: CE (+ NB no. Cat II+); π mark for TPED
eu.updates: Hydrogen-readiness of gas appliances under discussion
eu.summary: Pressure Equipment & Gas Appliances: Pressure Equipment Directive; Simple Pressure Vessels; Gas Appliances Regulation. NB: CONDITIONAL → YES.

eu.name: Toys
eu.mandate: Toy Safety Directive (new Toy Safety Regulation with DPP agreed 2025)
eu.testing: EN 71-1 (mechanical/physical), EN 71-2 (flammability), EN 71-3 (migration of 19 elements), EN 71-4/-5 (chemistry sets), EN 71-7 (finger paints), EN 71-13 (olfactory games); electric toys: EN 62115; phthalates & REACH Annex XVII checks
eu.whenNb: Self-declaration if ALL applicable harmonised standards applied; NB EC type-examination mandatory where hEN don't exist, don't cover all hazards, or weren't (fully) applied
eu.route: CE — DoC or NB Type-Exam Cert
eu.updates: New Toy Safety Regulation agreed 2025: Digital Product Passport, chemical bans (PFAS, endocrine disruptors)
eu.summary: Toys: Toy Safety Directive (new Toy Safety Regulation with DPP agreed 2025). NB: CONDITIONAL.

eu.name: Textiles Ecosystem (TCLF)
eu.mandate: Textile Labelling Regulation (under review); footwear labelling; ESPR ecodesign
eu.testing: Fibre composition quantification (ISO 1833 series) for label accuracy; REACH Annex XVII restricted substances (azo dyes EN 14362, Cr VI in leather EN ISO 17075, nickel release); flammability where claimed; DPP data requirements incoming under ESPR
eu.whenNb: No NB — self-declared labelling backed by accredited lab test reports; market surveillance enforcement; ESPR delegated acts may add verification later
eu.route: No CE — mandatory fibre label; DPP incoming
eu.updates: Reg. 1007/2011 review ongoing; ESPR textile delegated act & Digital Product Passport expected
eu.summary: Textiles Ecosystem (TCLF): Textile Labelling Regulation (under review); footwear labelling; ESPR ecodesign. NB: NO.
